text:
Maya (CS): SoundWave needs a short SG peering + temporary throughput boost for a planned cutover. Request: 3x token QPS for 24h, add CIDRs to APAC proxy. Can team support?
Nora (SoundWave Ops): Cutover window Tue 21:00-23:00 UTC. IPs: 34.101.0.0/16 and 35.240.0.0/14. HTTPS only. Renewal chat in a few weeks so smooth migration important.
Ethan (NetOps): I can add the CIDRs. Auto-revoke at 48h? Confirm ports = 443.
Nora (SoundWave Ops): yes 443 only. 48h revoke ok.
Liu (Platform): We'll create a tenant-scoped migration_boost policy (3x) with a canary (5% for 10m). Also can bump tenant cache for the window.
Omar (SE): enable tokenization diagnostics and set per-request cap at 8k tokens to avoid runaway jobs.
Maya (CS): Plan: Ethan adds rule + auto-revoke, Liu schedules migration_boost, Omar enables diag & cache, Nora runs two synthetics and uploads results.
Ethan (NetOps): creating rule now. ETA 15m.
deploy-bot: egress-rule created id=egress-sw-178765, cidrs=[34.101.0.0/16,35.240.0.0/14], ports=[443], region=ap-southeast-1, auto_revoke=172800s.
Liu (Platform): rollout sw-migration-178765 scheduled: canary 5% 10m -> full. multiplier=3.0, expires=2025-08-18T23:00:00Z.
Omar (SE): snippet for flags:
```
tenant: soundwave
features:
  prefix_kv_cache: true
  kv_ttl: 7200
  max_cached_prefix_tokens: 4096
  tokenization_logging: verbose
  per_request_token_cap: 8000
```
Liu (Platform): pushing flags; will monitor memory and revert if >80%.
deploy-bot: rollout sw-migration-178765 started (canary).
Maya (CS): Nora please run: (A) 256-token gen x100 (B) 5k-token summarize x10. upload to onboarding drive. Capture latency, errors, and cost.
Nora (SoundWave Ops): uploads will go to https://redwooddrive.company/onboarding/soundwave/migration. On call Tue 20:30 UTC.
Omar (SE): canary looks fine. p95 ~150ms. token diag shows a few stalls; collecting logs.
Liu (Platform): promoting to full.
deploy-bot: rollout sw-migration-178765 promoted to full.
Nora (SoundWave Ops): tests complete: 256-token p95 120ms, 5k-token p95 420ms, no 5xx. logs uploaded.
Maya (CS): follow-ups: - Ethan confirm auto-revoke; - Liu share dashboards; - Omar draft exec summary for renewal; - Nora confirm customer OK.
Liu (Platform): auto-revoke executed; egress sw-178765 revoked after 48h. cache flags rolled back.
Ethan (NetOps): cleanup done.
Maya (CS): Customer reports cutover successful. Marking as positive renewal signal. Thanks all! :tada:
